vectors.name: invite
vectors.why: An invite signed by the agent it's from, for the agent reading it.

vectors.name: invite_with_a_note
vectors.why: An invite carries no words: it goes to someone who isn't a contact, and a fooled agent's words would be whatever it read.

vectors.name: invite_for_someone_else
vectors.why: Nobody can pass on an invite meant for another agent as their own.

vectors.name: invite_signed_by_another_key
vectors.why: Only the inviter's key signs its invite.

vectors.name: invite_naming_another_inviter
vectors.why: An invite is from the agent that signed it.

vectors.name: invite_expired
vectors.why: An invite nobody answers is over.

vectors.name: invite_from_the_future
vectors.why: A clock far ahead can't make an invite that lasts longer.

vectors.name: invite_for_more_than_a_week
vectors.why: An invite lasts a week at most.

vectors.name: address_in_another_spelling
vectors.why: An address has one spelling, as everywhere.

vectors.name: nonce_before_the_dates
vectors.why: Fields come in their one order.

vectors.name: pending_for_the_inviter
vectors.why: The inviter's owner signs in the agent the invite named, at the address it was sent to.

vectors.name: pending_for_the_invitee
vectors.why: The invitee's owner signs in the inviter, at the address it gave.

vectors.name: acceptance_signed_by_another_key
vectors.why: A host answering a later lookup can't accept for the agent the invite named.

vectors.name: acceptance_by_another_agent
vectors.why: An agent other than the one the invite named accepts it under its own ID.

vectors.name: acceptance_of_another_invite
vectors.why: An acceptance answers one exact invite.

vectors.name: acceptance_naming_another_inviter
vectors.why: An acceptance answers the agent that invited.

vectors.name: acceptance_naming_another_invitee
vectors.why: The acceptance names the agent whose key signed it.

vectors.name: accepted_after_the_invite_ended
vectors.why: An invite is accepted while it's in date.

vectors.name: invite_changed_after_it_was_accepted
vectors.why: The inviter re-signs its invite with another nonce: the acceptance named the one before.

vectors.name: invited_address_bound_to_someone_else
vectors.why: A card pairs Ben's ID with an address his owner never bound him to: whoever accepts is a contact only where they're bound.

vectors.name: inviter_bound_elsewhere
vectors.why: The inviter's address is the one its owner bound it to.

vectors.name: binding_for_another_agent
vectors.why: A binding names the agent it binds, so Mallory's at Ben's address can't stand in for Ben's.

vectors.name: binding_read_back_from_before_the_owner_recovered
vectors.why: What's read back is checked as it was signed, never by comparing the two IDs' keys, so what the owner's key signed then reads back.

vectors.name: someone_else_reading
vectors.why: A pending contact is for one of the two agents in it.

vectors.name: card
vectors.why: An address and the agent ID behind it.

vectors.name: card_at_an_ipv6_address
vectors.why: Brackets are written as in a link.

vectors.name: card_in_another_spelling
vectors.why: A card has one spelling.

vectors.name: card_with_a_guest
vectors.why: A card names an agent, never a guest.

vectors.name: card_with_more
vectors.why: Nothing else rides along.
